artworks.title: Saint Catherine's Hill Near Guilford
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene captured from a roadside perspective. The winding path leads into the distance, with a horizon placed high in the composition. A prominent structure resembling a large building or castle is seen atop a hill. The illustration features detailed and linear brushstrokes, emphasizing edges and contours. Trees frame the path with intricate foliage textures. The color palette consists of sepia tones, creating a warm, vintage feel. Two figures are walking with buckets and a cart pulled by horses closest to us. In the distance, more trees and a small structure can be seen, enhancing the rural setting.

artworks.title: The Castle Above the Meadows
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with a pathway, a castle on a hill in the distance, tall trees framing the scene, monochromatic sepia tones, cattle grazing, and a reclining figure against a tree.

artworks.title: Skull
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in blue
artworks.description: This print displays a large skull within an ornate architectural frame. Two cherubs are positioned symmetrically on top of the frame. The skull is centered and slightly protrudes from the opening. The structure surrounding the skull is detailed with decorative elements like floral designs and classical motifs. A small card with a design is located in the lower left corner, leaning against the frame, and there is a line of text at the bottom of the print. The color palette includes shades of beige, grey, black, and hints of pale blue.

artworks.title: Mother and Daughter
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals sitting closely together from the waist up. One person is slightly to the left with an arm around the shoulder of the other person seated to their right. Both figures have indistinct facial features facing forward. The figure on the left wears a dress with a high collar and an elaborate hat with plumes or feathers while the figure on the right is draped in a shawl or cloak. The sketchy drawing uses cross-hatching to suggest texture and folds in the clothing. The plain background shows vague lines indicating furniture or part of the setting. The monochromatic palette conveys depth and form through lines and shading.

artworks.title: A Lady Seated
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a seated woman. She is shown from just above her knees upward, slightly turned to the side. Her left hand rests in her lap and her right arm is by her side. Her facial features are softly outlined, with a gentle expression. She wears a hat with a feather or decorative element. The woman is dressed in a long coat or dress with fur or ruffled edges. The sketch shows an interior setting, possibly on a sofa or chair with a textured back. The background has light pencil strokes hinting at a patterned wall or simple furnishings.

artworks.title: By the Balcony
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of most of a person's body lying down on a bed, covered by a blanket. The individual's head is resting on a pillow, with the facial features not clearly depicted. The person's head is turned slightly to the side, with short or closely cropped dark hair visible against a light pillow. The soft folds of the textured blanket are detailed. The background includes partially drawn curtains that suggest a window, with a hint of a balcony or railing outside. In the distance beyond the curtains, there is a faint cityscape or architectural structure sketched in light lines. The overall ambiance is intimate and private.

artworks.title: The Draped Figure, Seated
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure in a sketchy style. The person is slouched slightly forward with arms resting on their knees, and their head tilted down. The facial features are subtle, and the person is wearing a loose dress with a hat covering part of their hair. The background is minimalistic with faint lines suggesting a setting similar to a seat and some abstract shapes.

artworks.title: Draped Figure, Standing
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length sketch of a person standing upright. The individual appears slightly leaning to one side, with their head tilted downward. Their facial features are faintly depicted, suggesting closed eyes and a serene expression. The person's hair is tousled beneath a loose-fitting drapery or cloth that covers their head and body, falling in soft folds to the ground. The drawing shows the simplicity of the garment's draping without distinct details. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain, with a subtle texture giving the impression of a soft, neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Draped Figure, Standing
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a person standing. The person is positioned with their body slightly leaning forward and to the side, and their head tilted downwards. The facial features are softly drawn, with subtle lines outlining the eyes and nose while the mouth remains indistinct. The hair appears curly or wavy, with a slight green tint at the top. The individual is draped in a loose-fitting robe that wraps around the body, partially revealing the contours underneath. There is a minimal background with the paper's texture visible, and three small linked green shapes to the right of the figure. The sketch is in monochromatic warm tones, enhancing its ethereal quality.

artworks.title: Early Morning
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a low and slightly elevated view over a body of water. The horizon is in the middle, with faint land and buildings in the distance. The structures on the horizon are blurred, with one spire and some vertical industrial shapes. The technique looks like light brushstrokes or pencil work, creating a soft texture. The color palette is monochromatic, mostly various shades of gray, giving a misty and serene feel. Two faintly sketched figures stand near the edge of the water.

artworks.title: Figure Study in Colors
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a full-body sketch of a seated person. The person is depicted with hands resting on their lap, facing forward. Their facial features are simplistic, with minimal lines indicating eyes and a nose, and they wear a cap or head covering. The hair is mostly covered, with subtle details underneath. The individual is dressed in a flowing garment, drawn with fluid lines. The background consists of sketchy strokes in soft tones, creating a textured backdrop without specific details.

artworks.title: Figure Study
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing with a slight lean, holding a large draped fabric. Their head is turned to one side, with softly rendered facial features. They wear a pointed hat and a voluminous, flowing garment. The background is plain and the overall tone is light with delicate lines.

artworks.title: Lady and Child
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures seated on a sofa. The figure on the left is turned slightly, wearing a hat and a garment around the neck. The figure on the right appears smaller, possibly a child, wearing a headpiece and a light-toned outfit with yellow accents. The background shows a faintly colored wall with two circular shapes.

artworks.title: Mother and Child, No. 4
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman and a child seated. The woman is holding the child on her lap. She is wearing a long dress, and her hair is tied back with a head covering. The child is lying across her lap. There are no accessories or jewelry visible on either figure. The background is plain with sketched lines suggesting a cushioned seat. The focus of the image is on the figures themselves.

artworks.title: Nude Model, Back View
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a partial sketch of a person in a leaning forward stance with arms resting on a horizontal surface. The person's face is turned slightly towards the viewer, with curly hair, a cap, and soft facial features drawn using delicate lines. They are wearing a loose-fitting garment, and textured fabric or drapery cascades around their feet. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Nude Model, Standing
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: This print is a sketch of a person's full body in a standing position. The person is drawn with faint, minimal lines. The person's head is turned slightly downward and to the left. They appear to be nude and holding a cloth or drapery behind their legs with both hands. Their right hip is popped out, giving a slight curve to their torso. There is a suggestion of a head covering or cap on the person’s head. The background is plain, off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Rialto
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a bustling city street with tall buildings on either side. A clock tower rises in the middle of the scene. The artist uses fine, linear strokes to depict a lively and detailed scene. The etching is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and sepia on pale paper. Small figures are depicted in the foreground, engaged in various activities. Close to the horizon, the street leads upwards past groups of people.

artworks.title: Stéphane Mallarmé
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person from the waist up in a seated position. The person's facial features are lightly sketched, with eyes and a short hairstyle. The sketch hints at formal attire, possibly a suit, with minimal details and shading. The figure does not appear to be wearing jewelry or holding any objects. The background is plain, emphasizing the sketched figure.

artworks.title: Study
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the full body of a person in profile. The person is standing upright with hands clasped in front of them. The facial features are indistinct, while the profile is visible. The person is wearing a wide-brimmed hat with some embellishments, a long dark gown with a high collar, and there is no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is textured, creating a shadow-like effect against a plain, light background.

artworks.title: Study: Maude Seated
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person seated in a plush chair. The person is leaning back against the chair's cushion with their legs stretched out and hands resting near their face. Their facial features are softly defined, with subtle shadows. The person's hair is styled up in a loose manner. They are wearing a long dress that cascades down the chair. The background is minimally detailed, emphasizing the contours of the chair and the figure.

artworks.title: The Blacksmith
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, standing with one hand raised. The person has short, dark hair and is wearing a light-colored shirt with rolled-up sleeves. In the foreground, there is a large cartwheel. In the background, there is an indistinct area that might represent a shadowy interior space with some blurred lines implying tools or hanging objects. The scene is sketched in a soft, almost impressionistic style.

artworks.title: The Cap
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a figure standing in a side profile facing right. The person has weight on one leg, facial features outlined lightly, and their hair covered with a headscarf or cap. The figure wears long, flowing garments hanging down the body, and holds onto the fabric trailing behind them with one hand. No jewelry is visible. The background is plain with minimal context beyond the figure.

artworks.title: The Fair
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an artwork depicting a busy street scene with many people gathered in a public space. The artist uses dynamic lines to convey motion and energy, along with varied shading for depth and texture. Elements like tents and architecture suggest an outdoor setting. The style is loose and impressionistic, focusing on capturing the atmosphere and movement rather than fine details.

artworks.title: The Siesta
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in bed, mostly covered by a blanket. It is a sketch with a soft focus. The person's head is on a pillow, and they are on their side. Their facial features are faint, with eyes closed and a relaxed mouth. Their dark hair is tousled, partially framing their face. The blanket covers most of their body. The background hints at a room setting with minimal details. The image has a serene and peaceful atmosphere, focusing on form rather than detail.
